question:
Vilas went from his home to his college. He started his journey facing East. First, he went 2 km straight; then he turned to his right and went 3 km; finally, he turned left and walked 4 km to reach his college.

To which direction is Vilas’s home located in relation to his college?
solution:
We have drawn the following figure according to the information given in the question,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0d97f693f9a00831a0814b1f48610f41470fe5cbb73ae31fb0180d5967a362f.png] 

Hence, Vilas’s home is in north - west direction in relation to his college.
